resolved_issues.original_flaw: Protocol v1 evaluated all 4 models on Test and picked winner with highest Test Macro-F1 among those passing Test gates, leaking test data for model selection.
resolved_issues.resolution: Implemented 3-stage architecture: Model selection and operational gates occur strictly on Validation split. Exactly one model (M*) is frozen as Validated Operational Candidate before test unblinding. Test evaluation is strictly confirmatory for M*.

resolved_issues.original_flaw: Parent-job FAR (<=15%) was listed in metrics hierarchy but omitted from Gate 2 acceptance definition.
resolved_issues.resolution: Audited denominators: Test has only 3 pure-normal jobs; Val has only 4. A single false alarm causes Job FAR to jump to 33.3% (Test) or 25.0% (Val). Job FAR is formally designated as a Secondary Diagnostic Metric with integer reporting, while Entity FAR (<=10%) and Window FPR (<=5%) form Gate 2.

resolved_issues.original_flaw: Matching algorithm was described in high-level prose without handling repeated alerts, repeated failures, or post-failure exclusion.
resolved_issues.resolution: Formally specified matching algorithm on pre-failure windows (y in {1, 2}), single-credit counting, lead-time formula, and provided 4-scenario hand-checkable walkthrough.

resolved_issues.original_flaw: Bootstrap was proposed without addressing small cluster count (J=11), job size skew (job 6127642779 has 660 of 1025 windows), or undefined denominators.
resolved_issues.resolution: Simulated 1,000 cluster replicates: proved 0% missing classes, 3.1% missing pure-normal jobs. Defined explicit NaN-replicate exclusion and mandated dual reporting (cluster bootstrap CIs + entity-level CIs + point estimates).

resolved_issues.original_flaw: Unclear whether features were normalized using old entity split scaler or new Candidate A training scaler.
resolved_issues.resolution: Verified that features can be scaled cleanly using Candidate A training split statistics; verified GroupBy('entity_id') prevents cross-entity leakage; documented 81.3% CPI missingness and lag initialization.
